role: XMPP group membership and room scalar administration
known_patches: Integer identity schemas and integer internal seeds; preserve text username PK
Synthetic User1/2 and session.account_name normalization for existing username/JID owner predicates
Actual room/roster/affiliation filters; remove default truncation
limitations: All 39 original tools remain; only eight declared group/room metadata writes are certified. No post_channel/send_dm capability is claimed.
Source has no chat send interface or Group read/list interface; room description is the readable carrier, and group operations need known names.
Many group operations lack authentication/admin guards; MUC/PubSub affiliation checks may find privileges in unrelated rooms/nodes. No general ACL isolation claim.

New mucroom_create omits operational permission/default flags and initial owner affiliation; existing canChangeSubject=true rooms support subject writes. This is scalar metadata, not a complete channel provisioning workflow.
PubSub item/storage operations, privacy enforcement, account lockout enforcement and message delivery are not certified; metadata writes do not prove runtime network effects.
New MucRoom.roomID can differ from returned internal id because the source auto expression adds an extra offset; use mucroom_search metadata for the actual roomID.
